summary: Iter 75 VA Commission Teams — end-to-end backend + frontend verification. 13/13 pytest backend tests pass. Frontend UI (admin /ops/va-program/teams and VA /va/team) verified after fixing missing AdminVATeams import in App.js that caused a full-app ReferenceError white screen.

ui_bugs.issue: AdminVATeams was referenced by Route but never imported → 'ReferenceError: AdminVATeams is not defined' crashed the ENTIRE app (any route showed 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay). Fixed by adding `import AdminVATeams from "@/pages/admin/AdminVATeams";`

action_items: Nothing outstanding — feature works end-to-end. Main agent should be aware I fixed a missing import in App.js (AdminVATeams). Please confirm you accept this test-fix or move the import to your own preferred spot.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js: AdminVATeams route was wired without an import — this bricked the app until fixed. Recommend a lint rule (`no-undef`) run in CI to catch this class of bug pre-merge.
Override math is correct and idempotent (_apply_team_override upserts by lead_id+kind='team_override'; frozen once approved/paid to prevent retroactive drift).
_ensure_commission_for_lead correctly excludes kind='team_override' from the member lookup (find_one filter) — regression avoided.
pm_update_lead_stage 'lost' uses update_many across both member + override records — clean rollback semantics.

GET /va/team correctly gates on user.is_team_lead flag; VA nav (VALayout requiresTeamLead) matches. However, after admin toggles is_team_lead, the VA must re-login for the nav to update since the flag is loaded once from the auth context (documented in problem statement — acceptable).
test_credentials: admin@hcobcleaners.com / HcobAdmin2026!, va.demo@hcobcleaners.com / VaDemo2026! — flagged/unflagged via mongo during tests, restored to is_team_lead=false + team_lead_id=null on teardown.
seed_data_creation: Test leads prefixed lead_TEAMTEST_* were seeded directly in mongo for override-math tests and DELETED in teardown along with their commissions. is_team_lead and team_lead_id flags on va.demo (user_963e6aede023) and user_7f11e268d4b9 are reset in the fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 75 VA Team commission overrides fully working. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_iter75_va_teams.py can be re-run for regression. It self-cleans mongo state (removes seeded lead_TEAMTEST leads/commissions + resets team flags on both users). If you re-run frontend UI tests, be aware the VA must re-login after any admin is_team_lead toggle for the nav to reflect it.
rca_of_the_issue: One CRITICAL frontend bug found and fixed by testing agent: /app/frontend/src/App.js registered `<Route ... element={<AdminVATeams />} />` but did not import AdminVATeams. This caused a React ReferenceError at initial render, making the ENTIRE app show 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay — not just the teams route. Fix: add `import AdminVATeams from "@/pages/admin/AdminVATeams";` alongside the other admin page imports. After fix, admin flow (save-override-pct, promote lead, add/remove member, demote) all pass on the live preview URL.
